_units: robot base frame, mm, radians; rz = gripper yaw

plate._note: production plate measured with calipers 2026-10-19 (operator). Grip grooves are small: jaw width reads the same on the wall and in the groove (see gripper.readings). Height and groove position still to measure

plates._note: one entry per plate type (procedures/plates.py). grab_height_mm is added to every seat pose Z before a pick or place (vendor template VAR7). A type may carry its own jaw: {open: {short_edges, long_edges}, closed: {...}} in E1 pendant readings; without it the type uses gripper.open/closed, which the teach and measure commands write. id is SYSINVAR8 for the Lua path and lua/data_plate.lua must hold the same numbers. default names the type used when nothing selects one

ssh._note: SSH login of the box for calibration.upload (cli.py calibrate <camera> upload): user plus password or key_path. null refuses; nothing is hard-coded here or in the code

front._note: second view of the seat from the front camera before lowering: a tilted plate or something tall that the down camera misses. Trains itself per gate and state (<gate>_front), blocks once trained

hub._note: true: every gate writes its photo path, verdict and step to <outbox>/<check>.jsonl and every step its outcome to outcomes.jsonl, the training data for cephla-hub (perception/hub.py). Off by default; the data never leaves this machine without the opt-in upload job

seated_front._note: front camera at release, bottom band. auto: blocks once auto_refs references are collected; true/false override

slot_check._note: references are collected live by the cell (place approach = empty, pick approach = occupied); 24 at 30 min spacing cover a day's lighting. Delete reference_images/slot_<S> to relearn a slot

vision._front_led_note: front camera frames (slot view, seated check, plate in gripper) are lit by the camera LED so day and night match; validated 2026-10-19 21:15

stage_check._note: down camera at the clear pose above the stage, before it rotates: the plate must look seated and nothing else in view. References collected by the cell per direction (to_0, to_90); auto: blocks once auto_refs are collected

vision._marker_note: the marker tab (aruco标定板 drawing): 40 mm ArUco on a 42x60 mm steel tab, two countersunk holes 30 mm apart. Decoded from the drawing with OpenCV as DICT_ARUCO_ORIGINAL id 682; the box is addressed with aruco_marker_id 1 and that works on this cell, so the box numbers markers its own way. Read by the vision box only (get_aruco_pose, get_pose_offset), never by the SDK or BioyondWorks
vision._calibration_limits_note: 5 px / 1 mm: the solver reaches 3 px and 0.38 mm on the real captures; 0.5 px is not reachable with the poses a plan can show the tag from (synthetic captures with 0.3 px noise stop near 2.3 px)

gripper._note: open is per grip: the microscope holder limits how wide the fingers may be when descending

readings._note: value = finger gap. 2026-10-19 new fingers + production plate (small grooves): long edges 1.45, short edges 22.40, both measured in 0.1 mm steps with a clean stall. Fingers clamped on the wall ABOVE the groove read 22.37 (short) and 1.50 (long): 0.03 and 0.05 mm from the groove values, so the jaw width cannot tell groove from wall on either side; groove validation needs the cameras or controller torque detection. Old teaching plate with old fingers read 2.84 / 24.0 (sd 0.001 / 0.007 over 985 grasps)

gripper._tolerances: grasp 0.08 (fresh grasp, measured sd 0.007); release 0.3 (0.6 mm, a carried plate may settle)

accept_band._note: 2026-10-22 new plate, grips read by hand in drag mode (operator): short 24.87, long 3.68; band = closed -0.1/+0.5 (short) and -0.1/+1.05 (long) as for the production plate. Opens widened by the same 2.5 / 2.2 so the clearance per side stays the same. Fixture signatures (microscope grasp_width) cleared: learned again by the first picks.

microscope._note: microscope at x 123 y 400; polar stage sits at x 317 y 305, same y band but 200 mm away in x and 200 mm lower, so the zone is bounded in x
microscope._rule: inside the zone only vertical linear moves with fixed yaw; elbow swings happen below y 152 or on the taught route
microscope._needs_parked_note: the arm enters only while the microscope reports its stage parked (devices.squid parked); run.py homes the stage and waits for it inside the arm lock
microscope._free_above_z_note: From the operator (2026-10-28), heights above the base: stage lips 210 mm, stage 190 mm, flatfield module 260 mm; the platform top is robot z 35.6 (CAD 93 + k), so the highest part is about robot z 296. The claw's lowest edge is the wrist z - 25: from wrist z 350 it clears everything by about 30 mm. Above this height the no-swing rule (vertical moves only) does not apply, so the camera can be moved sideways to see the tag.
microscope._max_lateral_note: 5.0 (was 2.0): the taught route ends 3 mm from the microscope pose that was re-taught after it; the hover is a free-air spot (nothing within 70 mm above the holder), so a 3 mm correction there is harmless. The seat shift the setup accepts is this value too.
microscope._max_yaw_note: 3.0 (was 0.5): the taught route ends at yaw 90.1, the microscope pose was re-taught at 87.8; the hover is a free-air spot

stage_sweep._note: the Squid stage's full travel envelope at its closest approach to the arm's origin: a y band ('a horizontal asymptote on y') no part of the arm, tool point, elbow or links, may cross at any time. Measure on the cell: {x: [..], y: [..]} in the robot frame, optionally z. null = inactive and preflight refuses

regrip_above._note: 2026-10-20 23:30: first close wider than this -> open and close again (up to regrip_max, default 2) to square a robot-placed plate in the clips

grasp_search._z_note: z dropped 2026-10-20 17:50: the holder's height is fixed and a borderline 22.42 had lowered the seat another 0.3 mm (264.69 -> 264.39, floor 262.5); lateral trials only
grasp_search._note: tactile centering when the jaw stalls wider than the plate; the holder clamps the plate so the seat must match it within ~0.1 mm. 2026-10-20 17:05: a hand-placed plate needed y+0.4 (22.59) and more; max raised from 0.4 to 0.8

corrections.why: search 2026-10-19 22:05: z-0.5 gives 22.50 twice (groove), z 0 gives 22.64, z-1.0 gives 22.77; hand measure 22.40 with the plate free

microscope._taught_note_2026_10_22: re-taught on the route's elbow branch (j3 -172.1, as the cycle reaches it): x, y, yaw by hand with the plate seated (operator), z kept from the first pick that gripped (267.101; the hand put it 1.4 mm higher, 268.47). Replaces the mirror-branch seat (elbow +174.8) saved earlier tonight.

pose_at_90._back_grip_note: 2026-10-22 new plate is gripped 31.675 mm further back along its long axis (operator; same shift as the hotel slots in world x). At the stage at 90 the tool x points along world -y (yaw -91), so the shift is +y: the fingers hold the plate nearer its far end.

open_width._note: 2026-10-20: jaw end stop 29.3; 3.3 mm per side around the 125 mm plate at 0 instead of 1.8 (collision stop 10-19 23:08)

grasp_search._note: yaw removed: the wrist is near its limit at the stage seat and yaw moves were refused (22:27 loop, collision stop 22:57)

polar._grasp_note_2026_10_22: new plate, plate hand-centered on the stage at 0 then regripped 4x by the arm: 24.87/24.88/24.87/24.88 (flat, square); equals the hand reading 24.87

approach._note: pre-approach 100 mm in -x of the slot at slot z + lift, yaw = slot yaw; slide +x without rotating; then lower. The B column's approach point is 36 mm from the arm's axis: the planner reaches it by a joint move (routes/plan.py).

hotel._headroom_note: 30-plate hotel, 2026-10-22: 17 mm above a seated plate. preflight refuses a run while lift_mm is not below it; lift_mm 25 predates this hotel and must be re-taught from the plate height and the finger stand-off

_a1_check.verified: 2026-10-15 placement test, A1 x corrected +2 mm by operator

hotel._climb_note: rows above 1: retreat from the junction (row-1 approach point) to x=climb_x in free air in front of the rack, climb with the column only, slide in at carry height. climb_x = the operator via point x (2026-10-19). B and C columns wait for the FK-based planner: their approach points lie close to the shoulder axis at (126,0)
hotel._loaded_note: ground truth (operator, 2026-10-28): column A holds plates on the odd rows, column C on the even rows, B none

_x_offset_2026_10_22.note: new plate is gripped further back (operator, C2 long edges at x 261.37 against the interpolated 293.05): every taught slot pose x shifted by dx; dy/dz not applied

hotel._tray_note: From the CAD: shelves 8 mm thick every 38 mm of row pitch. The carry lift is cut to what the gap between two trays allows (procedures/hotel.py _lift_for).

microscope_2._note: second microscope (the dead one on the test rig). Teach: cli.py record-pose microscope_2, then regions.microscope_2 (box, z_floor), then trace + normalise microscope_2_to_polar. preflight lists what is missing: cli.py preflight

ext_axis._note: stage turns -90 (axis reading decreases) from parallel-to-x to the long-edge orientation
ext_axis._speed_note: speed 0.3 turns 90 deg in 3.5 s with the readback exact (tried 0.12: 6.6 s, 0.2: 4.6 s, 0.3: 3.5 s on 2026-10-28; 0.02 took 60 s for 180 deg). Raise with cli.py rotation-speed X --save
ext_axis._forward_note: the stage turns freely 0..100 deg the configured way (axis reading falling from zero_reading); a half turn goes the other way round (360 - deg backwards): the operator turned it by hand on 2026-10-28, and commanding -180 the configured way stopped at axis reading -10.1

polar._name: rotation module: the plate turntable on the arm's base, driven as the arm's external axis E2. 'polar' is its name in the code

volumes._note: Solid things the planner routes around (routes/plan.py), from the manufacturer CAD (hardware.json 'cad'). Robot frame, mm. z is the CAD height plus k = -57.4, which assumes the wrist axis sits at the fingers' mid height; it is checked against the taught seats to about 1 mm (module top 59.6, hotel row-1 shelf top 66.6 against TCP 66.8 and 74.6) and is refined by one finger-on-platform touch (hardware.json cad.mapping.k).

claw._note: Body and fingers as rectangles in the tool frame (x along the fingers, y across), relative to the wrist axis the controller reports; z relative to the reported z. Links and the carriage ride above the claw.

held._note: The plate in the claw, as rectangles in the tool frame: its centre is 219.9 ahead of the wrist on the long edges (hotel: taught wrist x 261.7 against the CAD plate centre 481.6) and 186.5 on the short edges (module: wrist y 304.5 against axis y 118). The plate's front edge may be this far inside the hotel's footprint: at the approach point it is above the slot, about 33 mm in, before it slides in.

routes._note: routes.plan: a taught trajectory <a>_to_<b> wins; otherwise lift to safe_z_mm, travel, lower. null = refuse. positions: the named places move_to knows, used to pick the taught route from wherever the arm is

nest._note: The nest, taught by the operator by hand: a safe pose the planner reaches from anywhere and where the arm goes after any fault (python cli.py recover --nest). The hotel view: the front camera looks along the claw. For an empty claw. clear of the hotel and pillar with the full margin

limits._stage_park_timeout_note: how long run.py waits after home() for the stage to report parked before stopping; same bound as step_timeout_s, not a measurement

microscope._note: stage position (Squid stage frame, mm) where Microscope.home_xyz leaves it, and how far from it still counts as parked. Measure on the cell: home, read stage.get_pos(), repeat a few times. null = parked() refuses. base_path and experiment_id go here too (devices/squid.py)

_stress_profile_note: stress = 50/25/10 %, grasp tolerance 0.08 (10x the measured sd), slow zone 6 mm; validate supervised before unattended
